name: Consonite Clusters

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves

disable: DC 23 Acrobatics check (trained) to Squeeze through the caps between the needles.

items.name: Needle Fall
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches any consonite cluster

---

Effect The needles snap, and the vibrations resonate with some of the surrounding clusters. The falling minerals deal 2d10+9 untyped damage to creatures within a 5-foot burst surrounding the triggering individual (DC 22 Reflex save save). The needle fall does not involve every consonite growth within these squares, so can be triggered again from the same location.

text: Consonite forms needle-like stalactites that can easily break free if touched, setting off a chain reaction that threatens to pierce anyone who stands in the area.
